[1/2] new seeds AIKit's AGPL-3.0 LICENSE, a Built with AIKit badge and a description paragraph; --description (10-350 chars) and repeatable --topic (GitHub rules, aikit always added) validated and kept in project.json (ADR-198); [2/2] publish sets the recorded description and topics on GitHub (ADR-199)

impact_assessment.why: User request: every new project starts AGPL-3.0 licensed, with a proper description, tags, and a README badge that leads to AIKit.
impact_assessment.benefits: New projects are licensed, discoverable by topic and described from the start; their README links back to AIKit.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new gains --description/--topic, its seed README and first commit gain LICENSE and a badge, publish runs gh repo edit for topics; dependency: AIKit's own LICENSE file is the source; concurrency: another agent commits in this repo, so each commit is preceded by a log check; state: project.json gains optional description/topics.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first tests per behaviour; validation before anything is created; a topic failure after a created repo is a note; README and help updated in the same commits; Phase 4 and verify_commit per milestone.

impact_assessment.why: User request: an attached project shows AIKit Integrated; references/ stays off GitHub and out of AIKit's gates; review since the last push found the description kept twice, so publish could upload a stale one; the user authorized the push.
impact_assessment.benefits: Attached projects link to AIKit; foreign reference code never fails AIKit's gates or reaches GitHub; one description source.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: attach now edits README.md (badge, idempotent, uncommitted), publish reads the description only from the README with a 350-char cap, find_python_files skips root-gitignored directories; dependency: none; concurrency: another agent may commit, so HEAD is checked before every commit and push; state: project.json no longer gains description.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first tests; ADR names the changed truncation expectation; Phase 4 and verify_commit for every commit; push never forced and only after each unpushed commit passes alone.
